edit.description: represented preflight: a discovered skill named as the starter's reference refuses with instructions before any write

summary: A represented fresh install whose discovered skills include one named `temper` refuses up front, naming the collision, instead of scaffolding a program whose first emit fails
acceptance: Install --yes over a tree holding .claude/skills/temper/SKILL.md exits non-zero, names the collision and its remedy, and writes nothing under .temper/
tests: represented install refuses a discovered skill named like the starter reference before writing
notes: From build note FRESH-INSTALL-SCAFFOLD-CALLS-STARTER: the scaffold composes starter(), whose reference emits .claude/skills/temper/. The lift writes member modules before the first emit, so the duplicate surfaces after writes; 'no half-scaffolded state' entails the up-front refusal.
